correctness.rationale: For b>=3, the two-step graph is a clique blow-up of an odd cycle; each q-coloring has a unique size-b color support and 2b maximum size-(b+1) supports. Maximal supports are indexed by their unique missed edge, and deficient support by its three missed edges. The spare-color criterion rigorously identifies degree as b sum max(0,g_j-3); the ordered compositions of excess 3 yield precisely 0,b,2b with exact multiplicities. Standard-library independent support enumeration for b=3..8, direct two-step graph tests at b=3,4 and separate transfer counts at b=3,4 agree. No infinite inference is based solely on finite tests.

value.rationale: Natural extremal one-unit support slack gives a full, nontrivial degree-profile of optimal injective colorings rather than a parameter substitution. It classifies absorbing states of single-site recoloring and calculates their fraction tending to one, a sharp threshold-specific phenomenon relevant to color sampling and reconfiguration. This differs from known maximal-degree-plus-one sparse-frozen-coloring regimes; the object and exact local statistic are mathematically motivated.
